items.claim: Anthony Wint won his Contender Series fight in 34 seconds with 13 significant strikes to zero.
items.quote: Anthony Wint is now 7-0 with a win at the Contender Series in 34 seconds. 13 significant strikes to zero. Got Matt Adams out of there quickly.

items.claim: Terrance Chapman has four of his five wins by knockout.
items.quote: five wins, one loss. So, recently and four of those five are by KO. So, he's capable of winning in that way.

items.claim: Terrance Chapman has a 32% takedown defense.
items.quote: Roman just has a 32% takedown defense, so it's not great.

items.claim: Roman Dolidze is coming off back-to-back losses by decision to Caio Borralho and submission to Anthony Hernandez.
items.quote: He's coming off back-to-back losses to CLD by decision, Anthony Hernandez submission.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder is moving up to light heavyweight after suffering losses to Caio Borralho and Brendan Allen at middleweight.
items.quote: Now, D Ridder is moving up. Why? Because he lost to Caio Borralho by decision and Brendan Allen fourth-round TKO.
